enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Stretch arms. Yawn. Turn to back. Adjust fan speed. Remain still. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning hygiene (washing face, brushing teeth, etc.)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn on tap. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Add milk. Stir. Cook. Flip. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink milk. Stand up. Place plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Brush hair. Pick up bag. Pack laptop. Pack phone. Pack keys. Zip bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold bag. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit as community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Type replies. Attend meeting. Talk to colleagues. Take notes. Make phone calls. Write reports. Print documents. File papers. Stand up. Walk to copier. Make copies. Return to desk. Continue working.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Eat. Talk to colleague. Drink water. Clear tray. Throw trash. Walk outside. Walk around block. Return to office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit as community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Discuss project. Take notes. Make phone calls. Send emails. Write proposal. Print documents. Review budget. Meet with volunteer. Give instructions. Return to desk. Update database. Prepare materials. Organize files. Stand up. Sit down. Continue working.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit down. Look at phone. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter house. Close door. Put bag down. Take off shoes.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat. Stand up.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Turn up volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Return to couch. Sit down. Drink. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for personal tasks or leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type password. Open browser. Check social media. Scroll. Open email. Reply to email. Open document. Write. Save. Close document. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Close laptop. Stand up.

Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Stretch legs. Yawn. Turn to back. Adjust fan speed. Remain still. Sleep.
